decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting information: Existing site location planExisting block planPre-existing block plan dated 02/09/2026Existing site location plan dated 02/09/2026Proposed drawingsProposed block plan dated 04.09.2026Section AASuds layout planSuds pro forma Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction detailed within the approved drawings / application form. Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the area

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.

No excavation, digging, trenching or other ground works shall take place below the existing ground level without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. No trees shall be felled, lopped, topped, uprooted, pruned or otherwise damaged in connection with the development. Any mixing of concrete and the storage of building materials, plant, machinery or waste shall take place outside the root protection area of retained trees and as far away from retained trees as reasonably practicable.Reason: To safeguard the health and longevity of retained trees and to protect local visual amenity during construction, in accordance with Policies G5 and G7 of the London Plan (2021), Policy DMD 80 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014)
